description:
Hello! 

We are high schoolers interested in aerospace engineering and cybersecurity. 

We would love to welcome anyone who is willing to put in the effort and work with us for the next 2 days! 

This is our first time participating in this event, so if possible, we are seeking individuals who are experienced in coding/other skills relevant to this hackathon.

日本語と英語、両方いけます！
